# Implementation Plan - Refactor "More" Tab to Hub & Spoke (Scalable Router Pattern) We will restructure the layout of the "More" tab into a clean, modern **Hub** layout. To ensure maximum future scalability and prevent code bloat, we will implement: 1. A **single dynamic subscreen modal** (`#settings-subscreen-modal`) featuring a **scalable router pattern** (`openSettingsSubscreen`). Adding a new section in the future will require zero core logic changes. 2. A **dedicated Notes Manager modal** (`#notes-manager-modal`) triggered by the floating action button (FAB) next to the `+` button. This button is hidden by default and can be enabled/disabled from the application settings. --- ## Scalable Subscreen Router Architecture ### HTML Structure Each section inside `#settings-subscreen-body` will share a common class `.subscreen-section` and be uniquely identified as `#subscreen-[screenId]`: ```html

``` ### JS Router Logic `openSettingsSubscreen(screenId, titleKey)` will handle navigation generically: ```javascript function openSettingsSubscreen(screenId, titleKey) { // Translate title dynamically const titleEl = document.getElementById('settings-subscreen-title'); if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = translate(titleKey) || titleKey; // Hide all sections document.querySelectorAll('.subscreen-section').forEach(section => { section.style.display = 'none'; }); // Show the target section const targetSection = document.getElementById('subscreen-' + screenId); if (targetSection) { targetSection.style.display = 'block'; } else { console.error(`Subscreen section "subscreen-${screenId}" not found.`); return; } // Trigger optional custom lifecycle init hooks const initHook = window['onSubscreenShow_' + screenId]; if (typeof initHook === 'function') { initHook(); } openModal('settings-subscreen-modal'); } ``` *To add any new section (e.g. `notifications`), we just add `
...
` to the HTML, register a translation, and optionally write a `window.onSubscreenShow_notifications` function.* --- ## Proposed Changes ### 1. HTML Markup: `index.html` #### [MODIFY] [index.html](file:///c:/Users/mario/Desktop/money-manager/index.html) - **More Screen (`#more-screen`)**: - Replace the entire scroll content with: - Profile Header card (Name, email, avatar). - Group of high-level Hub Rows calling `openSettingsSubscreen` programmatically: - ⚙️ **Προτιμήσεις Εφαρμογής** -> `openSettingsSubscreen('preferences', 'settings_pref_title')` - 🔁 **Επαναλαμβανόμενες Συναλλαγές** -> Opens existing recurring modal - 🏷️ **Διαχείριση Κατηγοριών** -> Opens existing category modal - 🗑️ **Κάδος Ανακύκλωσης** -> Opens existing trash modal - ☁️ **Δεδομένα & Συγχρονισμός** -> `openSettingsSubscreen('sync', 'settings_data_title')` - 👥 **Διαχείριση Οικογένειας** -> `openSettingsSubscreen('family', 'settings_family_title')` - 💬 **Σχόλια & Αξιολόγηση** -> `openSettingsSubscreen('feedback', 'settings_feedback_title')` - ℹ️ **Λογαριασμός & Νομικά** -> `openSettingsSubscreen('legal', 'settings_account_legal_title')` - **Single Dynamic Subscreen Modal (`#settings-subscreen-modal`)**: - Contains `.subscreen-section` containers for `preferences`, `sync`, `family`, `feedback`, and `legal`. - **Notes Manager Modal (`#notes-manager-modal`)**: - Contains: Search bar, Count badge, Notes List container (`#notes-manager-list`), and "+ Νέα Σημείωση" action button. --- ### 2. Stylesheet: `style.css` #### [MODIFY] [style.css](file:///c:/Users/mario/Desktop/money-manager/style.css) - Style the new `.more-hub-row` layout and items. - Ensure the dynamic subscreen wraps clean transition styles. --- ### 3. Application Logic: `app.js` #### [MODIFY] [app.js](file:///c:/Users/mario/Desktop/money-manager/app.js) - **Router Implementation**: - Add `openSettingsSubscreen` implementation. - Define lifecycle hooks: - `window.onSubscreenShow_family` to refresh partner status. - `window.onSubscreenShow_feedback` to reset rating selection and text area. - `window.onSubscreenShow_preferences` to ensure form values are synchronized from local storage. - **Event Listeners**: - Programmatically bind click event listeners to the Hub Rows on `#more-screen`. - Bind click listener for closing the subscreen modal and the notes manager modal. - **Notes Manager logic**: - Update notes handlers to target `#notes-manager-list` and `#notes-manager-modal`. - **Form changes**: - Programmatically bind preferences select items and checkboxes inside the subscreen view. --- ## Verification Plan ### Automated Tests - Syntax validation check via Node: ```powershell node -c app.js ``` ### Manual Verification 1. Open the "More" tab and ensure it displays the redesigned layout. 2. Tap each Hub row and confirm that `#settings-subscreen-modal` opens instantly showing only the correct child view. 3. Toggle the "Notes Shortcut Button" setting: - Verify that the pencil button is hidden when toggled off. - Verify it appears when toggled on. 4. Tap the pencil icon FAB: - Confirm it opens the **Notes Manager Modal** with search, list of notes, and "+ New Note". - Tap "+ New Note" and confirm the editor opens correctly. 5. Compile and deploy via `build_and_deploy.ps1`.
